content:
If you embrace the social aspects, studying at a university will broaden your horizons more than anything I have ever encountered could.

If you embrace the academic aspects, mathematics will empower you to see the world in a more constructive way than anything I have ever encountered could.

Good on you :-) I hope you get to embrace both and thoroughly enjoy the years ahead! You'll never ever be this free again. Cherish it and get everything you can out of it.

(I'm sure that many paths in life can provide good angles on these things too. But in my 40 years of existence, the things I cherish the most – after my family and loved ones – are time well spent at universities, and math.)
